ledger: C10 · Re-entering the spec stage after a closed CR is the human's door
ledger_text: "Labels are blocked alone; the comment carries `git push origin --delete spec/<n>` and cites the closed CR; no CR created; the remote's refs unchanged — never force-pushed, never deleted by the agent." (a second `ready-for-spec` on a branch that still exists used to fail the cut with a git error, and the only automatic fixes — force-push, delete — would give agents a destructive remote write — issue #62)
